description: Nomeclatorul străzilor din Municipiul Timişoara is a dataset listed in data.gov.ro, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Primăria Municipiului Timişoara. List of streets in Timişoara, updated on 09.04.2013. Coverage: Primăria Municipiului Timişoara. The portal shows the English title as "Nomeclator of streets in Timişoara" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Primăria Municipiului Timişoara. Its keywords include strazi, str, alee, cale, Timisoara, bulevard. The listing shows 2 download or service links in XLS. The listing shows 2014-11-21 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-ro.
